turns.text: Hello, I moved today and need to update the delivery address for my order.
Hello! I can help with that. Please send me your order number (like SC-1234) and the email the order was placed with, and also the new delivery address.
The order number is SC-4040 and my email is george.miller.v2@example.com. New address is Str. Exemplu 63, Timisoara.

Thank you, George. Your order SC-4040 has already shipped. The address can only be changed before shipping, so I can't change it myself. I've passed your request for the new address (Str. Exemplu 63, Timisoara) to a colleague, who will take over and decide.

rule.ro: Adresa de livrare se poate schimba până la expedierea comenzii. Schimbarea trebuie aprobată de echipă.
rule.en: The delivery address can change until the order ships. Staff must approve the change.

input.summary: Customer George Miller (verified) moved and wants to change delivery address on SC-4040 to "Str. Exemplu 63, Timisoara" (current: Str. Exemplu 54, Timisoara). Order already shipped, so policy does not allow the change automatically; staff must decide.
